top_band: warm tan/brown top surface across rows 0-7 (back rim row 0, main top plane rows 1-4, front edge highlight row 5, front thickness/lip rows 6-7)
evidence: Rows 1-5 form a clear foreshortened top surface with a bright front-edge highlight at row 5, followed by a cornice step (rows 6-7) and a dark 2-row eave shadow (rows 8-9) over the vertical front face (rows 10-30). The door panels (rows 12-25) have dark top/left inset shadows showing recessed construction.

style.evidence: While the wood ramp has 6 brown tones and some grain specks on the top, the left, right, and bottom outer borders are solid pure black (rows 1-31 on the sides, row 31 at the bottom), giving it a boxed/sticker border unlike the Beodeul references which use dark brown/material tones or selective outlines. The door panels are also mostly flat vertical bands compared to the richer wood grain on the reference stall.
